TCD.note: The taxpayer census is a municipal one, not a population census or survey.
The document states nothing on national ID enrolment.
The document states nothing on local government office connection.

facts.fact: Journal du Tchad reports the N'Djamena commune launched a digital taxpayer census with digitalised municipal revenue collection at the Central Market on 21 April 2026, enrolling the first traders, with rollout to other markets and districts to follow.
